accept.name: Meshy
accept.userValue: Actively developed end-to-end AI 3D creation platform for text, image and conversational generation, production-ready meshes, texturing, topology, rigging, animation, 3D printing and API workflows.
accept.description: End-to-end AI 3D creation platform for generation, texturing, topology, animation, printing and API workflows.
accept.useCase: For game, product, maker and 3D teams that want to move from references or prompts to editable production assets quickly.

accept.name: Tripo AI
accept.userValue: Active AI 3D modeling platform for text, single-image and multiview generation with high-detail or smart-mesh outputs, texturing, segmentation, retopology, rigging and animation.
accept.description: AI 3D platform for text/image generation, smart meshes, texturing, retopology, rigging and animation.
accept.useCase: For creators and studios that want production-oriented 3D assets for games, VFX, printing, ecommerce and interactive applications.

accept.name: Spline AI
accept.userValue: Active AI generation inside Spline for turning text and images into 3D assets that can be dropped directly into Spline's collaborative interactive design environment.
accept.description: AI-assisted 3D generation inside Spline's collaborative interactive design environment.
accept.useCase: For web and product designers who want generated 3D assets to remain editable inside an interactive scene and prototyping workflow.

accept.name: Kaedim
accept.userValue: Active managed 3D production platform that turns briefs, sketches, references and product photos into inspectable studio-quality assets for games, product design and commercial CGI.
accept.description: Managed AI-assisted 3D production platform for converting briefs and references into studio-ready assets.
accept.useCase: For studios and brands that need scalable 3D asset production with quality control and human-in-the-loop refinement.

accept.name: Masterpiece X
accept.userValue: Active generative 3D playground and API for rapid text- and image-driven asset prototyping, remixing and export to common 3D pipelines.
accept.description: Generative 3D platform for rapid asset prototyping, remixing and developer API workflows.
accept.useCase: For creators who want a low-friction way to explore and prototype 3D assets before deeper work in Blender, Unity, Unreal or other production tools.

accept.name: Hyper3D Rodin
accept.userValue: Actively maintained Hyper3D Rodin model and API family for high-fidelity 3D generation, texturing and production-oriented geometry with current Gen-2.5 capabilities.
accept.description: High-fidelity AI 3D generation and texturing platform built around the Rodin model and API family.
accept.useCase: For developers and 3D teams that need high-quality generated geometry and textures through a web product or production API.
